summary: Show the window and give it focus.

target.notes: Requires an ElectronCompat native-window abstraction so object lifetime and window events remain observable.

caveats: OS focus-stealing rules can prevent an application from receiving focus exactly as requested.

tests.name: show hidden window
tests.expected_behavior: window becomes visible and Electron requests focus

tests.name: show destroyed window
tests.expected_behavior: must not silently recreate a destroyed BrowserWindow
